Theorem
[Exponential convergence of regular simplex volumes] \group mostow Source: thurston:page-0143, thurston:page-0144

If $\sigma _E\subset H^3$ is regular with all edge lengths $E$, then $v_3-v(\sigma _E)$ decreases exponentially in $E$.
